target: S2 insertion rule (docs/PLAN.md:28) and the insertion-feasibility analysis (docs/DECISIONS.md:62-70, :80-88)
claim: The S2 strain limits exceed the elastic limits of the project's own material model. The insertion analysis also uses a third, different set of numbers. (1) Hard PLCL: S2 allows 3 % strain during insertion. The material card used in every cage model has E_hard 649.53 MPa and strength 15 MPa, so the elastic limit is 15 / 649.53 = 2.31 %. The analysis instead says 'yield strain ~5 % (25 MPa / ~400 MPa)', but 25 / 400 = 6.25 %, not ~5 %. Three numbers (2.3 / 5 / 6.25 %) are in play, and the adopted limit lies above the one the simulations use. (2) Compliant PLCL: S2 allows 40 %, but the card gives 3.0 / 8.194 = 36.6 % (linear estimate; for an elastomer the strength / E ratio is only a rough proxy, unverified). An insertion that passes S2 can therefore exceed the strength used by S6 / S8 in the same pipeline. (3) The 2 mm transient-distraction default rests on a source about FINAL over-distraction ('final disc-height gain >= 2 mm ... harmful', Sci Rep 2023, DECISIONS.md:69 and :85). A transient intra-operative limit is a different quantity: the source neither supports nor forbids 2 mm transient. The rule is labelled 'default pending surgeon confirmation', which is correct, but the cited evidence does not back the number. (4) The 35-41 % compression figure for contour-matched cages assumes the whole column is compressed uniformly. With no bone shaping, the hard core must stay inside the insertable envelope, so the compliant parts carry all the interference. No calculation shows that 40 % compression of a 50:50 part fully recovers (PLCL viscoelastic recovery and permanent set are unverified), and the refill of the concavity that provides fixation depends on that recovery.
evidence: docs/PLAN.md:28 (S2: hard <= 3 %, compliant <= 40 %, transient <= 2 mm); docs/DECISIONS.md:67 ('yield strain ~5 % (25 MPa / ~400 MPa, no direct data)'), :69 and :84-87 (Sci Rep 2023 s41598-023-44998-4 on final disc-height gain; default <= 2 mm transient); 'biocage stimulation test 1'/human_study/al_v2/physio_fix/p062_gpu2/case.json params E_hard 649.53, sig_hard 15.0, E_soft 8.194, sig_soft 3.0. Arithmetic: 15 / 649.53 = 0.0231; 25 / 400 = 0.0625; 3.0 / 8.194 = 0.366.
how_to_reproduce: Read the cited lines and the case.json params; divide.

fix_options.option: Safety guard + PI: pick ONE PLCL property set (with a source) for both the simulation cards and S2; set the S2 strain limit below the elastic limit of that set with a margin (e.g. hard <= 1.5 %, compliant <= 25 %) until coupon data exist
Ask the surgeon (Haertl team) for the transient distraction limit explicitly, and cite Caspar-pin practice for transient values rather than final over-distraction studies

Add an insertion-recovery check: compress the compliant part to the S2 strain, hold for the surgical time, release; require recovery to within X % of shape (FEBio viscoelastic or literature creep-recovery data for PLCL 50:50)

summary_zh: 植入規則（S2）允許的材料應變，超過了本計畫模擬所用材料的彈性極限。（一）硬 PLCL：S2 允許壓縮 3%，但所有 cage 模型使用的材料參數是硬度 649.53 百萬帕、強度 15 百萬帕，換算彈性極限只有 2.31%。植入分析文件又寫「降伏應變約 5%（25 除以 400）」，但 25 除以 400 其實是 6.25%。目前同時存在 2.3%、5%、6.25% 三個數字，而採用的上限比模擬用的還高。（二）軟 PLCL：S2 允許 40%，材料參數換算只有 36.6%。（三）「暫時撐開不超過 2 毫米」引用的文獻，談的是手術後最終椎間高度增加 2 毫米以上有害，並不是手術中暫時撐開的上限，所以這個數字沒有文獻支持。（四）在不能修整骨頭的前提下，所有干涉都要由軟材料吸收；但沒有任何計算證明軟材料被壓縮 40% 之後能完全回彈，而 cage 填滿終板凹面、提供固定力，正是依靠這個回彈。
